status: example — a starting checklist of registration-relevant dimensions. It is NOT a statement of any regulator's rules. Your RA team must replace keywords, outcomes and basis with your jurisdiction's current regulations and guidance, citing each source.

dimensions.name: Intended use / indications / contraindications
questions: Does the change alter what the device is used for, on whom, or where?

dimensions.name: Working principle / mechanism
questions: Does the physical/measurement principle change, or only its implementation?

dimensions.name: Structure and composition / configurations
questions: Is the changed part listed in the registered structure/composition or model list?

dimensions.name: Performance requirements in the registered technical requirements
questions: Which registered performance items could the change affect, and does the new value stay within the registered limit?

dimensions.name: Software (registered version rule, significant updates)
questions: Does the change alter clinical functions, algorithms or safety-related behaviour, or only fix defects / improve non-clinical aspects?

dimensions.name: Patient-contacting materials
questions: Does any patient- or user-contacting material, supplier process or coating change?

dimensions.name: Sterilisation, shelf life, packaging
questions: Does sterilisation method, sterile barrier or shelf life change?

dimensions.name: Registered labeling / IFU content
questions: Does the change alter registered statements in the IFU/label, or only editorial content?

dimensions.name: Electrical safety / EMC relevant design
questions: Does the change affect insulation, power supply, emissions or immunity? Is re-testing planned?

dimensions.name: Manufacturing site / outsourced critical processes
questions: Does the change move production, or change a critical/special process or its supplier?

outcomes.likely_registration_change: Candidate: the proposal touches registered content. RA should assess before design work continues.
outcomes.needs_ra_review: Candidate: the proposal touches a registration-relevant dimension; impact depends on details only RA can judge.
outcomes.likely_within_registration: Candidate: the proposal appears to stay within registered limits; RA confirmation still required.
outcomes.insufficient_information: Cannot assess: registration items, version rule or proposal details are missing.

redesign_hints.outside_registered_limit: Explore whether the design objective can be met while the parameter stays inside the registered limit, without reducing safety or effectiveness. If not, plan the registration change early instead of after implementation.
redesign_hints.software_relevant_component_bump: Your version rule marks this component as registration-relevant. Check with RA whether the change is in fact a significant update. Do not re-label the version to avoid the rule: a version must describe the change truthfully. A smaller-scope variant of the change may be an option.
redesign_hints.structure_or_configuration: Check whether the change can reuse already-registered components/configurations, or be phased so that registration-relevant parts are submitted together.
redesign_hints.default: Discuss scope alternatives with RA before implementation; record the rationale in the change request.
